result.summary: The page is largely intact; the only clear visual defect is a nonsensical discount badge on the lower card. Partial clipping of the horizontal carousels and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior, not defects.

issues.description: The lower featured card shows a discount badge reading '-100%', which is not a meaningful discount value and looks like corrupted or placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Replace the badge with a valid discount (e.g. '-20%') or hide the badge when the discount value is missing or out of range.
